en-US.name: GroceryApp Assistant
en-US.summary: Add items to your shared family grocery list using voice.
en-US.description:
GroceryApp lets you and your family share a real-time grocery list. With this skill, you can add items, check your list, and mark items as done — hands-free.

To get started, link your GroceryApp account in the Alexa app. Then try:
- "Alexa, ask GroceryApp to add milk"
- "Alexa, ask GroceryApp what's on my list"
- "Alexa, ask GroceryApp to mark eggs as done"
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask GroceryApp to add milk to my list
Alexa, ask GroceryApp what's on my grocery list
Alexa, ask GroceryApp to mark eggs as done
